purpose: Correct Batch 005 feedback: the first sleep candidate used music that felt cheerful/festive, and the focus candidate collapsed back into uncomfortable white-noise perception. Batch 006 tests music semantics before mix polish.
hardGates: Reject any Sleep item whose main music feels cheerful, festive, bright, cute, cinematic, romantic, or performance-like.
Reject any Focus item that is perceived as white noise, pink noise, traffic mask, fan mask, or uncomfortable hiss.
Reject any item where environment/noise-like support occupies the main perceived attention.
Keep the first 20-30 seconds audible but calm; do not solve quietness by adding a noise bed.

candidates.title: Dark Descent — No Festive Melody
candidates.designRule: sleep music must feel dim, slow, and non-celebratory; no piano/guitar lead, no white-noise support
candidates.stateArc: low drone is already present -> darker pad slowly opens -> high detail disappears -> one stable night body remains
candidates.listeningQuestion: Does this feel like a quiet descent instead of pleasant/cheerful music?
rejectedPatterns: sleep content with cheerful, festive, bright, or narrative lead melody
focus content that is perceived as white noise or uncomfortable masking
noise, room tone, traffic, or fan used as the primary perceived content

sources.note: low sustained body; carries sleep identity without melody
slow harmonic descent; no bright theme
late depth only, not an event layer

candidates.title: Warm Stillness — Breath Without Noise
candidates.designRule: calm must be warm and intentional, with breathing-like phrasing from harmony rather than hiss or noise
candidates.stateArc: warm grounded pad appears immediately -> open meditation tone widens -> soft resonance returns once -> settles without drama
candidates.listeningQuestion: Does this create a calmer room around you, rather than simply playing pretty music?
rejectedPatterns: sleep content with cheerful, festive, bright, or narrative lead melody
focus content that is perceived as white noise or uncomfortable masking
noise, room tone, traffic, or fan used as the primary perceived content

sources.note: warm body from the start; avoids empty opening
opens the space without becoming a lead track
subtle tonal color; no foreground bell show

candidates.title: Clean Harmonic Workbed — No Noise Mask
candidates.designRule: focus must be upright and clean; no white/pink/brown noise, no room-tone masking, no traffic bed
candidates.stateArc: neutral pulse is audible immediately -> low anchor stabilizes -> restrained mid motion adds work energy -> remains non-performative
candidates.listeningQuestion: Can this sit under work without feeling like white noise or like a song asking for attention?
rejectedPatterns: sleep content with cheerful, festive, bright, or narrative lead melody
focus content that is perceived as white noise or uncomfortable masking
noise, room tone, traffic, or fan used as the primary perceived content

sources.note: clear focus identity; not a noise layer
small amount of motion, late and restrained
